claim_mirrors.canonical_before:
Assume the Axiom of Choice ([[def-axiom-of-choice]]). Let
$G=\prod_i\operatorname{GL}_{n_i}(\mathbb C)$ be a finite product of complex
general linear groups with $n_i\ge1$
([[def-invertible-matrix-and-general-linear-group]]), acting algebraically on a
separated finite-type complex algebraic variety $X$
([[def-classical-algebraic-prevariety-regular-maps-and-varieties]],
[[def-algebraic-group-action-and-scheme-theoretic-stabilizer]]). For integers
$N_i\ge n_i+1$ put
$$U_N=\prod_i\operatorname{Inj}(\mathbb C^{n_i},\mathbb C^{N_i}),\qquad B_N=\prod_i\operatorname{Gr}(n_i,N_i),\qquad X_N=(U_N\times X)/G,$$
where $G$ acts on $U_N$ by precomposition of frames and on $U_N\times X$
diagonally, and set $r_N=2\min_i(N_i-n_i)$. Let
$p_N:G^\bullet\times P_N\to G^\bullet\times X$, with
$P_N=U_N\times X$ and $p_N=(\mathrm{id},\operatorname{pr}_X)$, be the
simplicial map of the two action nerves
([[def-equivariant-constructible-derived-category-for-complex-algebraic-varieties]]),
and let $Q_N:D^b_{G,c}(X;k)\to D_c^b(X_N;k)$ be the composite of $p_N^*$ with
the locally split Čech descent equivalence for the principal bundle
$P_N\to X_N$
([[lem-locally-split-cech-nerves-give-derived-cartesian-sheaf-descent]]).
Then, for bounded algebraically constructible $A,B$ in $D^b_{G,c}(X;k)$:

1. **Hom comparison.** If $A\in D_c^{\le a}$ and $B\in D_c^{\ge b}$, then
   pullback induces an isomorphism
   $\operatorname{Hom}_G(A,B[m])\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{X_N}(Q_N(A),Q_N(B)[m])$
   whenever $m\le b+r_N-a$;
2. **full faithfulness.** On an ordinary cohomological interval
   $D_c^{[b,a]}$ of width $a-b\le r_N$, the functor $Q_N$ is fully faithful;
3. **image.** On such an interval the image of $Q_N$ consists exactly of the
   objects $H$ whose principal-bundle pullback $q_N^*H$ lies in the image of
   $\operatorname{pr}_X^*:D_c^{[b,a]}(X;k)\to D_c^{[b,a]}(P_N;k)$, i.e. of
   the resolution triples whose frame-bundle pullback comes from $X$; the
   image is closed under retracts, and under extensions when
   $r_N\ge a-b+1$;
4. **coherence.** For two resolutions $N,M$ and
   $r\le\min(r_N,r_M)$ the comparison isomorphisms $Q_N\cong Q_M$ on
   intervals of width at most $r$, obtained from the product resolution
   $U_N\times U_M\cong U_{N+M}$, are canonically determined, commute with the
   natural transformations of the construction, and satisfy the cocycle
   identity on products of three resolutions;
5. **trivial group.** If $G$ is trivial then $U_N$, $B_N$ and $X_N$ are $X$
   or a point, $r_N=\infty$, and $Q_N$ is the identity of $D_c^b(X;k)$.

No global tensor splitting
$Ra_{N*}a_N^*B\simeq B\otimes_kR\Gamma(U_N;k)$ is asserted for the
frame-bundle projection $a_N:P_N\to B_N$; the comparison is used only on the
nerve and through the finite local models.

separated finite-type complex algebraic variety $X$
([[def-classical-algebraic-prevariety-regular-maps-and-varieties]],
[[def-algebraic-group-action-and-scheme-theoretic-stabilizer]]). For integers
$N_i\ge n_i+1$ put
$$U_N=\prod_i\operatorname{Inj}(\mathbb C^{n_i},\mathbb C^{N_i}),\qquad B_N=\prod_i\operatorname{Gr}(n_i,N_i),\qquad X_N=(U_N\times X)/G,$$

$P_N=U_N\times X$ and $p_N=(\mathrm{id},\operatorname{pr}_X)$, be the
simplicial map of the two action nerves
([[def-equivariant-constructible-derived-category-for-complex-algebraic-varieties]]),
and let $Q_N:D^b_{G,c}(X;k)\to D_c^b(X_N;k)$ be the composite of $p_N^*$ with
the locally split Čech descent equivalence for the principal bundle
$P_N\to X_N$
([[lem-locally-split-cech-nerves-give-derived-cartesian-sheaf-descent]]).
Then, for bounded algebraically constructible $A,B$ in $D^b_{G,c}(X;k)$:

1. **Hom comparison.** If $A\in D_c^{\le a}$ and $B\in D_c^{\ge b}$, then
   pullback induces an isomorphism
   $\operatorname{Hom}_G(A,B[m])\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{X_N}(Q_N(A),Q_N(B)[m])$
   whenever $m\le b+r_N-a$;
2. **full faithfulness.** On an ordinary cohomological interval

   objects $H$ whose principal-bundle pullback $q_N^*H$ lies in the image of
   $\operatorname{pr}_X^*:D_c^{[b,a]}(X;k)\to D_c^{[b,a]}(P_N;k)$, i.e. of
   the resolution triples whose frame-bundle pullback comes from $X$; the
   image is closed under retracts, and under extensions when
   $r_N\ge a-b+1$;
4. **coherence.** For two resolutions $N,M$, use the common product resolution
   $U_N\times U_M$ and its associated quotient
   $X_{N,M}=(U_N\times U_M\times X)/G$ with projections
   $\pi_N:X_{N,M}\to X_N$ and $\pi_M:X_{N,M}\to X_M$.
   The pullbacks $\pi_N^*Q_N(A)$ and $\pi_M^*Q_M(A)$ are canonically
   identified on intervals of width at most $\min(r_N,r_M)$, and their
   Hom comparisons commute with natural transformations and satisfy the
   cocycle identity after pullback to a triple product resolution.
   No identification of $U_N\times U_M$ with $U_{N+M}$ or direct
   isomorphism of functors with different target categories is asserted;
5. **trivial group.** If $G$ is trivial then $U_N$, $B_N$ and $X_N$ are $X$
   or a point, $r_N=\infty$, and $Q_N$ is the identity of $D_c^b(X;k)$.

$Ra_{N*}a_N^*B\simeq B\otimes_kR\Gamma(U_N;k)$ is asserted for the

nerve and through the finite local models.
claim_mirrors.manifest_statement_before: Assume the Axiom of Choice ([[def-axiom-of-choice]]). Let $G=\prod_i\operatorname{GL}_{n_i}(\mathbb C)$ act algebraically on a separated finite-type complex variety $X$, omitting zero-rank factors ([[def-invertible-matrix-and-general-linear-group]]). Let $U_N=\prod_i\operatorname{Inj}(\mathbb C^{n_i},\mathbb C^{N_i})$ with $N_i\ge n_i+1$, and $B_N=\prod_i\operatorname{Gr}(n_i,N_i)$; put $X_N=(U_N\times X)/G$ and $r_N=2\min_i(N_i-n_i)$. For $A\le a$ and $B\ge b$ in the actual equivariant bounded constructible derived category $D^b_{G,c}(X;k)$ of [[def-equivariant-constructible-derived-category-for-complex-algebraic-varieties]], the finite-resolution functor $Q_N$ gives $\operatorname{Hom}_G(A,B[m])\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{X_N}(Q_N(A),Q_N(B)[m])$ for $m\le b+r_N-a$. On an ordinary cohomological interval of width at most $r_N$ it is fully faithful; its image consists of the resolution triples whose principal-bundle pullbacks come from $X$. The image is closed under retracts. Products of sufficiently acyclic resolutions give coherent comparison equivalences. For the trivial group the identity model has $r_N=\infty$.

claim_mirrors.canonical_before: Assume the Axiom of Choice as inherited from the proper-hypercover theorem. Let $X_\bullet\to X$ be a proper hypercover and let $F$ be a coefficient complex in $D^b_c(X;k)$ with cochain lower bound $a$ ([[def-simplicial-object-and-simplicial-commutative-ring]]). Then the cohomology of the total complex in degree $m$, and its differential, are determined by the simplicial levels $p\leq m-a+1$ only; every hypercover truncation $\operatorname{cosk}_N\operatorname{sk}_NX_\bullet$ with $N\geq m-a+1$ computes the same $H^m(X,F)$. In particular for the constant sheaf $F=k_X$, where $a=0$, degree $n$ uses only levels through $n+1$. Level $n$ alone does not suffice: the differential out of the term $(p,q)=(n,0)$ of the Cech complex lands in the level $n+1$ term $(n+1,0)$.

Let $X_\bullet\to X$ be a proper hypercover and let $F$ be a coefficient complex in $D^b_c(X;k)$ with cochain lower bound $a$ ([[def-simplicial-object-and-simplicial-commutative-ring]]). Then the cohomology of the total complex in degree $m$, and its differential, are determined by the simplicial levels $p\leq m-a+1$ only; every hypercover truncation $\operatorname{cosk}_N\operatorname{sk}_NX_\bullet$ with $N\geq m-a+1$ computes the same $H^m(X,F)$. In particular for the constant sheaf $F=k_X$, where $a=0$, degree $n$ uses only levels through $n+1$. Keeping only the cochain terms through level $n$ and omitting the outgoing differential does not suffice in general: the differential out of the term $(p,q)=(n,0)$ of the Cech complex lands in the level $n+1$ term $(n+1,0)$.
